note: Invented for the public sample: no real code. Two real defects and one known wrong finding.

items.claim: The upload ends in || true, so it always succeeds: the retry never runs and a failed upload prints sent.
The retry waits a fixed five seconds with no way to shorten it, so every test that crosses it waits for real.
Claims the loop runs four times; with n from 0 and -lt 3 it runs three.
